units.source_text: 在估衣铺里，岛村也找到了一种雪国的麻质绉纱，拿来做夏装。

en.t: In a secondhand clothing shop, Shimamura also found a hemp crepe cloth from the snow country and had it made into summer clothing.

units.source_text: 这是村妇们在漫长的冬雪日子里用手工织成的。

en.t: It had been handwoven by village women during the long days of winter snow.

units.source_text: 由于从事舞蹈工作的关系，他认识了经营能乐［一种日本古典乐剧］旧戏服的店铺，

en.t: Through his work with dance, he knew shops that dealt in old Noh costumes, Noh being a classical Japanese musical drama,

units.source_text: 拜托过他们：如有质地好的绉纱，请随时拿给他看看。

en.t: and had asked them to show him whenever they came across good-quality crepe cloth.

units.source_text: 他喜欢这种绉纱，也用它来做贴身的单衣。

en.t: He liked this crepe cloth and also used it to make an unlined undergarment worn next to the skin.
